spans.s: audbilya, audvilya, nt. Śikṣ 〔183.6〕; cittaudvilyaprītikaraṇyodārayā prabhayā (cf. under udbilya) Gv 〔203.18〕; cittaudvilyakaraṇī (prabhā) Sukh 〔30.2〕.
